The University of Southern Denmark is hiring Associate Professors in Software Engineering, Interaction Technologies, Embedded Systems, and Cyber-Security.

Job call link:

Deadline to apply: 1st May 2026

*Associate Professors in Software Engineering, Interaction Technologies, Embedded Systems, and Cyber-Security*

Locations: Odense, Vejle, and Sønderborg in Denmark

SDU Software Engineering <
> in Odense, SDU Centre for Industrial Software <
> in Sønderborg, and SDU Centre for Software Technology <
> in Vejle, all part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute <

>, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), jointly invite applications for one or more associate professor positions within the broad area of software engineering and technology. The positions are open from Spring 2026, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates.
